protocol.pilot_claim_ceiling: The 48-task, six-repository Rust pilot and 24-pair human-escalation pilot are feasibility/variance-estimation instruments. They may produce descriptive and exploratory findings only; they do not establish SOTA superiority.
protocol.small_discordance_rule: For paired binary outcomes with fewer than 25 discordant pairs, use exact McNemar/binomial inference; do not rely only on the asymptotic approximation. Report discordant counts.
protocol.cluster_inference_rule: Tasks are clustered by repository and root-cause family. Report cluster counts and size distribution. Use pairs cluster bootstrap, wild-cluster restricted bootstrap or randomization-inference sensitivity. V0 conservatively treats 12 or fewer repository clusters as exploratory, not confirmatory; this is a policy guardrail, not a universal theorem.
protocol.multiplicity_rule: Preregister one primary endpoint and one primary contrast. Apply Holm step-down adjustment to confirmatory secondary metric tests; do not promote unadjusted secondary results to confirmatory claims.
protocol.noninferiority_rule: Fix the noninferiority margin before holdout access. The current -2 percentage-point candidate margin is not approved by default; it requires engineering justification and pilot-based design review. Claim noninferiority only when the one-sided confidence bound clears the margin.
protocol.hard_gate_rule: Critical security, evaluator-integrity, authorization or isolation failures are non-compensable. A qualified claim requires zero critical failures, qualified isolation/trust, independent regrade qualification, reference patch PASS and empty patch FAIL.
protocol.pareto_rule: Publish a vector across correctness, security, cost, latency, reviewer burden, abstention/escalation and evidence completeness. A Pareto claim requires non-inferiority on every preregistered dimension and a strict improvement on at least one; no arbitrary weighted aggregate is allowed.
protocol.seed_pseudoreplication_rule: The task or task-pair is the independent sampling unit. Seeds are repeated measurements nested within a task and do not increase the task denominator or repository cluster count.
protocol.zero_failure_rule: For zero observed critical failures, report an exact one-sided binomial upper bound only with the independent-trial assumption stated. Also report fault-family clustering; counting many related variants does not establish independent evidence.

claim_boundary: Design-only claim policy. No CEB performance claim, matched superiority result, non-inferiority result or Pareto-dominance claim is registered.
